notes:
Lead profile: small-mid SaaS vendor building in-app help widget. Heavy EU user base (Germany, NL). Trial created default region (us-east-1) which increases round-trip for EU clients.

Symptoms: intermittent p95 at 1.6-2.3s from EU; front-end records some requests hitting app timeout (10s) when long conversation history included. Node SDK used, not yet streaming. Some requests combine retrieval embeddings + full doc context into single prompt, increasing token size (~1k-1.8k tokens).

Customer comments: 'Feels sluggish for German users - support team getting complaints' and 'We saw occasional aborted replies when a user had long session history'.

Primary asks: simple, actionable guidance for hosted API (region selection), client timeout/read settings, prompt size guidance to reduce TTFP and p95, and quick mitigation steps they can apply during trial.

SE recommendations given on call and follow-up:
- Region guidance: switch trial app to eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) or eu-west-1 (Ireland) depending on user geo. Provide sample curl + env var to pin region. Run A/B test for 24-72 hours to compare p50/p95 and error rates.
- Timeouts: recommend split timeouts (connect=800ms, read=6-8s) for initial tuning; advise enabling incremental streaming (server-sent events / websocket) for chat routes to reduce perceived latency on >256 token responses. Note: some HTTP clients default to large timeouts; confirm client library config.
- Prompt best practices: maintain short moving window of recent 3-4 user+assistant turns; store a condensed system summary server-side (update every 6-8 turns) and prepend as single-line context rather than full history. For retrieval flows, do retrieval -> rank -> generate: use embeddings to fetch top-N doc snippets and include only highest scoring snippets (limit to ~300-600 tokens) rather than full doc body.
- Cost/latency tradeoffs: suggest trying smaller quantized model (if acceptable) as a fallback for non-critical routes; discuss caching repeated instruction responses and prefix KV cache for consistent prompts to lower token cost and improve p50.
- Observability: set up route-level metrics (p50/p95, tokens per request, error rate) by region; share Redwood Console sample dashboard and quick config guide.
- Client SDK tips: show Node example for streaming and timeout override; include curl pin-region example.

Proposed short POC (10 days):
- Day 0-2: pin EU region + capture baseline p50/p95; enable basic telemetry.
- Day 3-6: implement client read/connect timeout changes + enable streaming on chat route.
- Day 7-10: implement prompt truncation + system-summary caching; rerun metrics, calculate cost delta and error reduction.
Deliverable: one-page summary with before/after p50/p95, average tokens/request, and recommended production settings.

Conversion signals: if EU p95 drops below 800-900ms or perceived latency improved (via streaming) and cost delta <15%, high chance to convert to paid hosted tier. Avoid upsell to Dedicated now 5 customer wants public cloud self-serve.

Open items: need sample app telemetry (edge client latencies), confirmation on which EU region they'd prefer, internal budget timeline (end of month).
